followups.relationObserved: Same-record samples support positive PWM duty/DAC relationship in both directions. Direction voltage differences are reported descriptively, not declared equivalent under an unapproved tolerance.
followups.scopeOfConclusion: Positive paired relationship at measured points; no claim of zero update latency, causal identity of internal variable, exact directional equality or new PDF compliance approval.
